# Jax Tile & LVP

> Jax Tile & LVP is a trade name operated by Braga Remodeling (MB FLOOR AND TILE INSTALLATIONS LLC) in Jacksonville, Florida. It offers a fixed-price waterproof LVP (luxury vinyl plank) package and porcelain or ceramic tile installation. Phone (904) 520-1994.

## Business
- Name: Braga Remodeling, operating Jax Tile & LVP
- Legal name: MB FLOOR AND TILE INSTALLATIONS LLC
- Address: 4305 Napoli Rd, Jacksonville, FL 32207
- Phone: (904) 520-1994
- Email: braga@bragaremodeling.com
- Hours: Mon–Fri 7AM–9PM, Sat 7AM–6PM, Sun 8AM–3PM
- Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps/place/?q=place_id:ChIJ-bI5F1N2jYcRepVs4CTp9dc
- Other remodeling (bathrooms, kitchens): https://bragaremodeling.com/
- Service area: Jacksonville, Mandarin, Jacksonville Beach, Ponte Vedra, Nocatee, St. Johns, St. Augustine, Orange Park and Fleming Island, FL

## Published LVP prices
- LVP package: $3.99/sq ft for projects of 1,000 sq ft and up. Includes waterproof LVP from the in-stock colors, installation and standard cleanup.
- The $3.99 package and the Plus and Premium prices are for 1,000 sq ft and up. For smaller areas, call or text (904) 520-1994.
- Plus: $4.49/sq ft (adds shoe molding and a moisture barrier). Premium: from $4.99/sq ft (thicker plank). Same 1,000 sq ft minimum.
- Labor-only LVP installation (customer-supplied flooring): from $2.00/sq ft.
- Quoted separately: carpet and pad removal $0.50/sq ft; tile or glued-down removal from $2.00/sq ft; floating LVP or laminate removal $0.75/sq ft; dumpster $400 when we haul debris; leveling, shoe molding, transitions and stairs.
- Tile installation is quoted after a free measure; it is not priced from the LVP package.
